raw_definitions: Definisi : all his geese are swans , membesar-besarkan cerita ttg sso; cook so’s ~ , merosakkan + approp n : there’s no one to blame but himself – he cooked his own ~ when he quarelled with the boss , tdk ada siapa yg harus disalahkan – dia telah merosakkan peluangnya sendiri krn bergaduh dgn bos. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. web-footed water bird larger than duck , angsa: a flock of geese , sekawan angsa; 2. female of this bird , angsa betina; 3. ( meat, flesh ) angsa; 4. ( colloq ) simpleton , (orang yg) /bodoh, bongok/; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
